errors.evidence: In the description of the 'Only MoHD FFN' line, the starting value at 100% is stated as 11.6, but the plot shows it at approximately 11.45.
The 'Only MoHD FFN' line decreases to approximately 11.3 at an Activated Parameters Ratio of 50%, not 11.4.
The 'Only MoHD ATTN' line is plotted with circle markers, not diamond markers.
In the description of the 'Only MoHD ATTN' line, the starting value at 100% is stated as 11.6, but the plot shows it at approximately 11.45.
The 'Only MoHD ATTN' line does not remain steady until 50%; it clearly rises from approximately 11.45 at 100% to 12.2 at 50%.
In the description of the 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' line, the starting value at 100% is stated as 11.6, but the plot shows it at approximately 11.4.
The 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' line does not remain steady until 50%; it clearly rises from approximately 11.4 at 100% to 12.0 at 50%.
